details:
This update for go1.27 fixes the following issues:

Security issues fixed:

- CVE-2026-97033: cmd/go: unexpected code execution via --sysroot, -target, -isysroot, -Wl,-syslibroot, and -x cgo flags
  (bsc#1289978).
- CVE-2026-97034: cmd/go: arbitrary command execution via GCC spec files in cgo linker search directories (bsc#1289979).
- CVE-2026-97035: cmd/go: unexpected code execution and arbitrary file write via Clang -gen-* and GCC -gnat* flags in
  cgo (bsc#1289980).
- CVE-2026-97036: cmd/go: arbitrary code execution during build on darwin via "-l to_library" in cgo (bsc#1289981).
- CVE-2026-97037: cmd/go: linker script injection via split -Wl, flags and Darwin or symbol linker flags in cgo
  (bsc#1289982).
- CVE-2026-97038: cmd/go: arbitrary code execution via crafted .syso files and cgo linker input files (bsc#1289983).
- CVE-2026-97039: cmd/go: flag sanitization bypass via "#cgo pkg-config:" directives (bsc#1289984).
- CVE-2026-97040: cmd/go, cmd/link: cgo directive injection via .syso files disguised as Go object files (bsc#1289985).
- CVE-2026-97041: cmd/compile, cmd/link: host linker flag injection via //go:cgo_* directives (bsc#1289986).
- CVE-2026-97042: cmd/cgo, cmd/compile, cmd/link: linker flag injection via cgo_import_dynamic and PE DLL names
  (bsc#1289987).
- CVE-2026-97043: cmd/go, cmd/compile: unexpected code execution via escaped quotes in //go:cgo_ldflag (bsc#1289988).
- CVE-2026-97054: net/http: HTTP/1 server crash due to MaxBytesReader header race (bsc#1289989).

Changes for go1.27:

Update to version go1.27.4 (bsc#1272545):

 * go#81866 cmd/compile: branchelim optimization can eliminate result of store
 * go#81927 cmd/asm: amd64 assembler loops forever on a forward jump to a labelled PCALIGN when a branch needs widening
 * go#82023 net: Dialer.Dial{TCP,UDP,IP} incorrectly treats invalid addresses as ::
 * go#82106 cmd/compile: staticcheck still crashes with generic methods on Go 1.27.2
 * go#82150 runtime: linux/mips time64 nanosecond layout causes busy waits and empty CPU profiles
 * go#82334 cmd/dist: GOFIPS140 bootstrap from Go 1.26 fails
 * go#82536 crypto/tls: omit ML-DSA from signature_algorithms_cert in Go 1.27CherryPickApproved
 * go#82627 crypto/fips140: minor compliance improvements
 * go#82657 runtime: nil-pointer panic in a promoted-method wrapper becomes "traceback did not unwind completely" under -race
